translation: Ukettaɛ, tama n wayen-nniḍen, axxam n teqbaylit. Yerna i lmend ad t-ixebbeɛ, ad as-d-yini: Ccam, kker! Acemma i k-iḥeṛṛmen? Yessefk ad d-teffeɣ taqcict-agi seg uxxam, ɣer ṣṣifa i d-yenna Yahwe. Ad d-yas wass-nni, ad neḥbes ad nmeslay. Ihi ayen i d-yenna: ad tettunefk-ed teqcict i win ara yextir, ɣer wayen i d-yenna ⟨Yahwe⟩ ɣef ḥesed-nneɣ.
